operations.summary: Check whether a (size, MD5) pair already exists in the ddref tables.
operations.notes: Lightweight read-only probe used by clients (e.g. the WP plugin's resumable uploader) to decide whether to bypass the chunked upload and complete the file via create_file + close_file_upload with hash only. Does not create any file row or reserve storage.
